text.tspan: • Small inline text blocks, next to each other.
• Inline blocks are contained within a larger block.
• Examples: multi column grids and product cards.
• Show extra content without disrupting flow.
• Use as standalone clickable word or within a blocks.
Paragraphs with fonts, styles and layout
• Text flows naturally and wraps at the page's edge.
• Apply Emphasis: Indents, fonts, colors, sizes, bold, italicize, underline, etc.
• Words wrap automatically, redundant spaces removed.
• Blocks contain inline styled text or inlline blocks.
• Text can Wrap around narrow blocks.
• Blocks can be left, right or centered.
• Click to pages within book. Use for Glossary of terms, etc.
• Captions appear when an image is clicked.
• Examples: Pictures, illustrations and related graphics,
